entities.name: Tupi-Guaraní and Coastal Peoples
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Tupi-speaking peoples dominated Brazil's Atlantic coast at European contact, organized in semi-sedentary villages practicing slash-and-burn agriculture (manioc, maize), ritual warfare, and — controversially documented — anthropophagy. The Tupinambá, Tupiniquim, Potiguara, and many other nations
